description: Provenance of the Fermix wordmark the design module draws (FermixWordmark: Welcome's title and the Chats list's bar; the owner, 2026-10-10). fermix-wordmark.svg is a byte-identical copy of the file at source_path in fermix-macos at the pinned commit. Nothing reads it at run time and the APK does not carry it: WordmarkGeometry.kt holds its paths, translations and dots as Kotlin, and design's WordmarkGeometryTest holds them to this file, checks its digest below and that this directory holds no other file.
provenance_note: The engine's fermix_wordmark/1 component (fermix apps/fermix_web/lib/fermix_web_web/components/core_components.ex) saved as a file. fermix-macos added it at commit 266f283 and it is unchanged from there to commit, the Linux app's record of the same file (fermix-linux desktop/app/marks/PROVENANCE.json, key wordmark). macOS draws it as a 1:1 path port (Apps/Fermix/Sources/FermixAppCore/Design/Components/FermixWordmark.swift), its letters in Palette.ink and its dots #2b5cff.
licence: MIT, copyright 2026 Tezra, per the fermix-macos LICENSE; first-party artwork.
permitted_treatment: Shipped byte for byte here and drawn as a 1:1 port of its paths, scaled uniformly with the file's own margin. The letters are currentColor and take the app's ink; the two eye-dots keep the file's #2b5cff, the app's signal in both modes. Never redrawn, cropped or recoloured otherwise.
